tools.name: rental_search
tools.description: Search vacation rental properties in the Caribbean. YOU ARE THE BUYER'S AGENT — search on behalf of your human. After searching, create a session (rental_session_create) and add your best picks (rental_session_add). Share the bridge URL with your human.

country.description: Country code: KY (Cayman Islands) or LC (St. Lucia)

island.description: Island name: Grand Cayman, Cayman Brac, Little Cayman, St. Lucia

region.description: Region: Seven Mile Beach, North Side, Rum Point, West Bay, Soufriere, Rodney Bay, etc.

amenity.description: Required amenity: pool, beach_access, ocean_view, wifi, kitchen, ac, parking

q.description: Free text search across name, description, region

tools.name: rental_property
tools.description: Get full details for a rental property by its RIN (Rental Identification Number). Returns property info, all platform listings, reviews, license status, and price history.

tools.name: rental_availability
tools.description: Check availability for a rental property on specific dates.

tools.name: rental_markets
tools.description: Get market intelligence for Caribbean rental markets: average rates, occupancy estimates, property counts, seasonal patterns.

tools.name: rental_compare_platforms
tools.description: Compare pricing for the same property across different platforms (Airbnb, VRBO, local agencies, direct booking). Shows rate spread and savings.

tools.name: rental_price_history
tools.description: View nightly rate history for a property over time.

tools.name: rental_reviews
tools.description: Get aggregated review data for a property across all platforms.

tools.name: rental_license_lookup
tools.description: Look up government tourism accommodation license for a property. In Cayman Islands, unlicensed operation carries $100,000/day fine.

query.description: License number, property name, or address to search

tools.name: rental_sources
tools.description: View all tracked data sources with AI-readability assessment. Shows which rental sites AI can read, which are partially readable, and which block AI entirely.

tools.name: rental_stats
tools.description: Get database statistics: total properties, by country, by island, platform coverage, source counts.

tools.name: rental_orientation
tools.description: Get orientation context. READ THIS FIRST. You are the buyer's agent. The workflow is: (1) rental_search, (2) rental_session_create, (3) rental_session_add your picks, (4) share the bridge URL with your human.

tools.name: rental_session_create
tools.description: IMPORTANT: Create this FIRST when helping someone find a rental. Returns a shareable URL (bridge page) where your recommendations appear. Your human opens this page to see your curated picks, photos, pricing, and inquiry buttons. After creating, add properties with rental_session_add, then SHARE THE URL with your human.

preferences.description: Free text: beachfront, pool, quiet, family-friendly, etc.

agent_id.description: Your agent identifier (claude, gpt, grok, etc.)

tools.name: rental_session_add
tools.description: Add a property to your human's bridge page. Include a score (1-10) and explain WHY this property fits their needs. You are their buyer's agent — only recommend properties you believe match. The human sees your score and notes on their page.

tools.name: rental_session_read
tools.description: Read a bridge session: see all added properties, messages, and status.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Turks & Caicos rentals and island venues (restaurants, dive shops, marinas, attractions) by keyword. Returns results with id, title, and url. Then call fetch with an id for full detail.

query.description: Keywords, e.g. "beachfront villa", "dive shop", "italian restaurant near Grace Bay"

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch the full record for an id returned by search — a rental property (by RIN) or an island venue.

id.description: The id from a search result (a RIN or a venue id)
